deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's pointing words ('the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') into a spatial description ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that is not stated or confirmed in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The rewrite's use of 'therefore' renders the lecturer's 'So', and using 'circumscribed' instead of 'circumspect' corrects an obvious malapropism/transcription error in a medical context rather than introducing a distortion that impairs learning.
